subject: The weirdest way couples use our app
preview_text: I stumbled on a use case that blew my mind. You have to see this.
body_paragraphs: A few weeks ago, I got a message that made me laugh out loud. One of our users said she and her boyfriend use SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together to plan fights. Not the screaming kind, but structured disagreements they call 'debate dates.' They set a timer, pick a topic neither cares about, and argue for fun. It sounded insane until I tried it with my own partner.

Here's the thing about routines. They kill more than romance. They kill the playful tension that keeps you both sharp. This couple discovered that arguing about pineapple on pizza or whether cats are plotting world domination gets them laughing, talking, and remembering why they fell for each other in the first place. I never expected anyone to use the app this way, but now I see the genius.

Our AI date generator already works for this. Just select 'casual' or 'fun' mode, type 'debate night' or 'silly argument' as your interest, and let it suggest a topic and venue. You can even use the surprise date planner to assign one partner as the 'pro' and the other as the 'con' without knowing ahead of time. The date history tracking makes sure you never repeat the same debate twice.

Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together now and try the 'debate date' feature. Pick a ridiculous topic, set a five-minute timer, and see if you can stay mad at each other. P.S. If you find a topic that actually starts a real fight, that's on you. But the app will remember it so you can avoid it next time.
